decisions.reason: POWO/WCVP accepts Z. texana as a species in Poaceae; keep the installed species-level canonical identity.
IPNI and POWO agree on J. Wash. Acad. Sci. 23:454 (1933), with Hitchc. authorship and species rank.
POWO lists Z. aquatica independently among four accepted Zizania species; it is not an accepted synonym of Z. texana.
POWO lists Z. palustris as a distinct accepted species; molecular relatedness to Z. texana does not alter that rank.
POWO lists the Asian species separately; it is not an alias or subspecies of Z. texana.
POWO/WCVP lists four accepted species: aquatica, palustris, latifolia and texana; no extra accepted Z. texana rank should be invented.

decisions.accepted_target: No synonyms displayed for Zizania texana in current POWO treatment
decisions.reason: POWO Z. texana entry has no Synonyms section and TPWD states Other Scientific Names: None. This is a source-qualified absence, not proof that every historical misidentification has been found.

decisions.source_name: Zizania texana as a distinct concept despite molecular similarity
decisions.reason: Terrell et al. 1978 documented morphological distinctions from Z. aquatica and Z. palustris; later phylogenetic research reports close relationship to Z. palustris, not a formal synonymization.

decisions.source_name: Historical 1892 San Marcos specimen identified as Zizania aquatica
decisions.accepted_target: Do not automatically treat as modern Z. aquatica or as a valid Z. texana synonym
decisions.reason: EPA 2025 documentation reports an 1892 identification as Z. aquatica preceding Hitchcock's 1933 Z. texana description. This is a historical specimen misidentification, not a nomenclatural synonym or new canonical taxon.

decisions.source_name: Inference that Zizania texana must be merged into Z. palustris
decisions.accepted_target: Keep Zizania texana as a distinct accepted species
decisions.reason: Molecular proximity and shared genetic clustering are insufficient to override POWO/WCVP accepted species status or the original diagnostic concept.

decisions.source_name: Individual photographs, field observations and unvouchered specimen identifications
decisions.accepted_target: Zizania sp. or candidate Z. texana until corroborated
decisions.reason: Accepted name and literature comparisons do not authenticate any particular existing learner photograph or field specimen; preserve all current identity review holds.

decisions.source_name: Natural hybrid or introgressed ancestry involving Zizania texana
decisions.reason: 2010 and 2015 phylogenetic studies address relatedness and population genetics, not evidence that a particular learner specimen is a natural hybrid; do not infer hybrid ancestry from morphological intermediacy or shared alleles.

decisions.accepted_target: Source concept unresolved without original specimen and determination history
decisions.reason: Common-name or rankless records and historical Z. aquatica labels require original voucher, locality and diagnostic determination; do not reassign automatically.

decisions.source_name: Life-history descriptor conflict in Kew sources
decisions.accepted_target: Species accepted; default perennial supported, source wording unresolved
decisions.reason: POWO species summary calls Z. texana perennial while embedded GrassBase morphology says Annual. FWS calls it perennial but notes plants in slow-moving waters can function as annuals. Preserve exact source qualifiers; do not change species taxonomy based on a single unqualified descriptor.

decisions.source_name: Species-level molecular clustering versus accepted morphological rank
decisions.reason: 2015 microsatellite STRUCTURE analysis grouped Z. texana near Z. palustris rather than resolving a separate cluster at K=3. This is an interpretation limitation, not a published accepted-name change; keep genetic species-delimitation question source-qualified.
